Title: Struggle for development: the black communities of North & East Preston and Cherry Brook, Nova Scotia, 1784-1987
Abstract: A 103-page local history published in 1988 by Mohamed Abucar with the Black Cultural Centre for Nova Scotia as corporate creator, digitized in the University of Calgary's Local Histories collection.

curated.access_note: Digitized as a PDF in the University of Calgary Digital Collections.
curated.source_note: Held in Alberta; the subject is Nova Scotia communities. The date is the publication year, and the title gives the period covered (1784 to 1987).
